notes: s001 precedes its expressed head noun υἱοῦ across the intervening participle, so it keeps the English 'the' and the participle keeps the relative clause — rule 31's τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν … ἀδελφοῖς shape.

The supplied 'to be' is placed inside the participle's unit; placing it on the predicate noun υἱοῦ under rule 53, as ROM.1.1, 1.6 and 1.7 do for κλητός phrases, remains defensible and is not named in the unit note.
'even' is folded onto the anarthrous name under rule 105's noun-carrier arm, with the added reading noted as required.
